description: Source code for the 'scheme' API endpoints in Mattermost, handling CRUD operations for permission schemes including creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, with permission checks and license validation.

methods.name: InitScheme
methods.description: Initializes HTTP routes for scheme management endpoints.

methods.name: createScheme
methods.description: Handles creation of a new permission scheme, including license and permission checks.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves a specific scheme by ID, with permission validation.

methods.name: getSchemes
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of schemes, with scope validation.

methods.name: getTeamsForScheme
methods.description: Fetches teams associated with a scheme, validating scope and permissions.

methods.name: getChannelsForScheme
methods.description: Fetches channels associated with a scheme, validating scope and permissions.

methods.name: patchScheme
methods.description: Updates an existing scheme with new data, including audit logging and permission checks.

methods.name: deleteScheme
methods.description: Deletes a scheme by ID, with license and permission validation.
